rows.grounds: adjective indicating doubling of the previously mentioned measure
demonstrative pronoun referring to the measure stated in the preceding verses
fused form of kvacit (sometimes) and proktam (declared); internal sandhi noted, token kept unsplit
compound describing a temple apportioned into six parts (rasa = six)

items.question: Under what temple division is that measure sometimes declared to be twofold?
premises: The preceding context specifies a measure for the inner chamber and pedestal.
That same measure is sometimes declared to be twofold.
This twofold declaration applies in a temple divided into six parts.
items.inference: Therefore, when the temple is apportioned into six parts, the stated measure may be doubled.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'tat' (whether the pedestal, inner space, or total measure) depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: That measure is sometimes said to be double in a temple that is divided into six parts.
